title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
slides: Spotify changes algorithms tomorrow, but who decides what is AI?
New labels will tag AI Persona profiles explicitly.
Their music vanishes from recommendations yet remains searchable.
Artists using AI lose algorithmic reach without notice.
Check your profile now before the invisible cutoff.
thread_text:
1. Who decides what is AI?

Spotify changes its algorithms tomorrow to tag AI Persona profiles. But the definition of AI is still unclear.

2. New labels expose AI.

Profiles with AI Persona tags will be clearly labeled on the platform. You'll see them right away.

3. Music vanishes from your feed.

Songs from AI-tagged artists disappear from recommendations. They stay searchable but lose all algorithmic reach.

4. No notice before the cutoff.

Artists using AI get their reach cut without any warning. The change is invisible until it happens.

5. Check your profile now.

Open Spotify and see if you're tagged. Take a screenshot before tomorrow's cutoff.

instagram.caption:
Your playlists change tomorrow — songs from profiles tagged as "AI Persona" get pulled from recommendations, no warning, no appeal. 🎧

Spotify's new labels go live with an algorithm update. Who decides what counts as AI? The rulebook isn't public. Artists only find out after the cutoff hits.

Your music stays searchable but loses all algorithmic reach. Gone from Discover Weekly, gone from radio-style feeds. Chances to be heard shrink overnight, silently.

If you use AI tools in production — even for vocals or mastering — check your profile today. Screenshot everything before tomorrow.

Do you know if you're already tagged? 📸
